description: AURA Clinical Knowledge Base Repository for Deterministic Reasoning

conditions.name: Acute Coronary Syndrome
conditions.description: Acute myocardial ischemia or infarction causing chest pressure and systemic cardiovascular symptoms.
references: AHA/ACC 2020 Clinical Practice Guidelines for Acute Coronary Syndromes

conditions.name: Pneumonia
conditions.description: Infection of the pulmonary parenchyma resulting in systemic fever, productive cough, and dyspnea.
references: IDSA/ATS Consensus Guidelines on the Management of Community-Acquired Pneumonia

conditions.name: Upper Respiratory Tract Infection
conditions.description: Acute viral infection of the upper airway passages involving the nasal mucosa and pharynx.
references: CDC Guidelines for Common Cold and Upper Respiratory Infections

conditions.name: Asthma Exacerbation
conditions.description: Acute bronchospasm causing airway hyperresponsiveness, wheezing, and respiratory discomfort.
references: GINA Global Strategy for Asthma Management and Prevention (2023)

conditions.name: Hypertensive Crisis
conditions.description: Severe elevation in blood pressure associated with end-organ dysfunction signs such as headache and visual disturbance.
references: AHA/ACC Guideline for Prevention, Detection, Evaluation, and Management of High Blood Pressure

conditions.name: Hypoglycemia
conditions.description: Abnormally low blood glucose level leading to neuroglycopenic and autonomic symptoms.
references: American Diabetes Association (ADA) Standards of Care in Diabetes (2024)

conditions.name: Anaphylaxis
conditions.description: Severe, life-threatening systemic allergic reaction involving airway compromise or vascular collapse.

conditions.name: Acute Gastroenteritis
conditions.description: Acute inflammation of the gastrointestinal tract mucosa causing vomiting, abdominal cramping, and watery stool.
references: ACG Clinical Guideline: Diagnosis, Treatment, and Prevention of Acute Diarrheal Infections

conditions.name: Migraine
conditions.description: Recurrent neurovascular headache characterized by throbbing unilateral pain and sensory sensitivity.
references: American Headache Society Consensus Statement on Migraine Treatment

conditions.name: Influenza
conditions.description: Acute systemic viral infection caused by influenza virus featuring high fever, myalgias, and respiratory symptoms.

conditions.name: Acute Appendicitis
conditions.description: Acute inflammation of the vermiform appendix presenting with periumbilical pain migrating to the right lower quadrant.
references: WSES Jerusalem Guidelines for Diagnosis and Treatment of Acute Appendicitis

conditions.name: Pulmonary Embolism
conditions.description: Occlusion of pulmonary arterial vasculature by thrombus, causing acute dyspnea and pleuritic pain.
references: ESC Guidelines for the Diagnosis and Management of Acute Pulmonary Embolism

conditions.name: Cerebrovascular Accident
conditions.description: Focal neurological deficit resulting from acute cerebral ischemia or intracranial hemorrhage.
references: AHA/ASA Guidelines for the Early Management of Patients With Acute Ischemic Stroke

conditions.name: Urinary Tract Infection
conditions.description: Bacterial infection of the urinary tract mucosa causing dysuria, frequency, and urgency.

conditions.name: Acute Otitis Media
conditions.description: Acute bacterial or viral inflammation of the middle ear space.
references: AAP Clinical Practice Guideline: Diagnosis and Management of Acute Otitis Media

conditions.name: Acute Bronchitis
conditions.description: Self-limiting inflammation of the large bronchial airways usually secondary to viral infection.
references: ACCP Guidelines for Diagnosis and Management of Cough

conditions.name: Acute Sinusitis
conditions.description: Inflammation of the paranasal sinuses lasting less than 4 weeks, characterized by facial pain and purulent nasal discharge.
references: AAO-HNS Clinical Practice Guideline: Adult Sinusitis

conditions.name: Streptococcal Pharyngitis
conditions.description: Acute pharyngeal infection caused by Group A Streptococcus.
references: IDSA Clinical Practice Guideline for Diagnosis and Management of Group A Streptococcal Pharyngitis

conditions.name: Acute Cholecystitis
conditions.description: Acute inflammation of the gallbladder, typically resulting from cystic duct obstruction by a gallstone.
references: Tokyo Guidelines 2018 for Management of Acute Cholecystitis

conditions.name: Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease
conditions.description: Chronic mucosal exposure to acidic stomach contents causing pyrosis and regurgitation.
references: ACG Clinical Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease

conditions.name: Allergic Rhinitis
conditions.description: IgE-mediated inflammation of the nasal mucosa induced by environmental allergen exposure.
references: AAO-HNS Clinical Practice Guideline: Allergic Rhinitis

conditions.name: Tension Headache
conditions.description: Common primary headache disorder presenting with bilateral band-like pericranial tightness.

conditions.name: Acute Pancreatitis
conditions.description: Acute inflammatory process of the pancreas presenting with severe epigastric pain radiating to the back.
references: ACG Clinical Guideline: Management of Acute Pancreatitis

conditions.name: Nephrolithiasis
conditions.description: Formation of crystalline mineral deposits in the urinary tract causing severe colicky flank pain.
references: AUA/Endourological Society Guideline for Surgical Management of Stones

conditions.name: Cellulitis
conditions.description: Acute bacterial infection of the deep dermis and subcutaneous tissues.
references: IDSA Practice Guidelines for the Diagnosis and Management of Skin and Soft Tissue Infections
